name: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology PhD

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall full consideration and support
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; late applications space available.

applicationFee.note: International degree applicants: $70. Qualifying degrees/affiliations only; confirm eligibility. See central policy. International applicants should confirm the applicable category and documentation before payment.

english.note: PTE 58. Official scores within two years; qualifying country/recent-degree exemptions. Department may require more.

documents: Official transcripts/credentials and certified foreign translations
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor degree with B average; semesters of organic chemistry, physics, calculus and biochemistry (B or better), plus two upper-level BMB courses. Program requirements describe two single-spaced pages on goals/program choice and one on a research project; applying page requires its template.

funding.note: Published 2025–2026 stipend $34,500/year; current offer level individualized. University-funded support may be limited to six years. Tuition paid for PhD students in most instances; domestic nonresidents must establish residency by third semester. Outside jobs discouraged.
